new_data_role: Assistant-prepared sparse TRAINING labels based on user-confirmed tissue identities; not independent ground truth.
batch: 6 fields: 2 from clearer new crop (one centred on each tissue), 1 from confirmed Periderm crop, 2 archived mixed-tissue fields, 1 archived explicit Background field. 512 native pixels, random position, paired rotation/flip, gain0.8-1.2.
loss: New-label balanced CE+0.5Dice +0.25 archived-label balanced CE/Dice +2.0 class-balanced KL to frozen initial model on archived training fields only. No development-reference input to gradients.
trainable: Decoder and segmentation head only; whole encoder and all BN running statistics frozen.
selection: Check fixed steps100,200,300,400. Eligible if minimum recall on present classes in both new sparse training masks >=0.95 and old development tissue meanIoU >=0.60. Choose eligible checkpoint with highest old development tissue meanIoU; if none, preserve initial model as default and report adaptation inconclusive.
development_role: MT25 root4 reused for selection; not independent. Original PAT exposure unknown.
prediction_input: Image only. Reference masks used for loss/metrics separately.
method: Preserve old training-image predictions with frozen teacher; update decoder/head only.
